section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the impact of restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages on young adult women and men. It highlights that these messages are negatively associated with perceived familial body acceptance, body appreciation, and intuitive eating, and positively associated with perceived familial pressure to be lean, body dissatisfaction, disordered eating, and BMI. A key gender difference was observed: for men, these messages directly reduced body appreciation, while for women, this relationship was fully accounted for by perceived familial body acceptance.
